notes:
This release restores tracking that's been broken since the ER update: overmastery info, Skybound Art (SBA) gauge/attempts/executes, and pet/summon damage attribution (Ferry's ghost, Cagliostro's sled, etc).

New this release:  cast summons (Lucilius, Rolan, etc.) now attribute their damage to the summoning player"; equipped summons (with main trait and equip bonus) now track in log details; and weapon data is more reliable  in some online states.

Also fixes a memory growth issue during long/high-hit-count battles(Thanks to onelittlechildawa). Check release notes on github for more details!
